```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## load data

```{r read_vcf}
library(vcfR)
vcf_file <- "../data/snps/S15_filtered.vcf.gz"  # Replace with your VCF file path
vcf_data <- read.vcfR(vcf_file)

```

## QC mutations

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
dp_data <- vcfR::extract.info(vcf_data, element = "DP")  # Replace "DP" with your desired INFO field
dp_data <- as.numeric(dp_data)

fixed_data <- getFIX(vcf_data)
qual <- as.numeric(fixed_data[,"QUAL"])
fixed_data=cbind(fixed_data,dp_data) 
#we create a dataframe and convert some text data to numeric
fixed_data=as.data.frame(fixed_data) %>% mutate(QUAL=as.numeric(QUAL),dp_data=as.numeric(dp_data))

fixed_data=fixed_data %>% select(-FILTER,-ID)
```


Some basic plots for quality control

```{r plots}
library(patchwork)
# Histogram for QUAL
p1=ggplot(fixed_data, aes(x = QUAL)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, fill = "blue", color = "black", alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Variant Quality", x = "Quality (phred)", y = "Frequency") +
  theme_minimal()

# Histogram for dp_data
p2=ggplot(fixed_data, aes(x = dp_data)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, fill = "orange", color = "black", alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of variant read depth (DP)", x = "Depth", y = "Frequency") +
  theme_minimal()

p1+p2
```

# MAGs

We load the MAG information for each contig

```{r rmag}
mag=read.table("../data/snps/S15.ctg2bins.txt",h=F)
colnames(mag)=c("MAG","CTG")
fixed_data=left_join(fixed_data,mag,by=c("CHROM"="CTG"))

#contig coverage
ccov=read.table("../data/snps/S15_bins.depth.mosdepth.summary.txt",h=T)
ccov=left_join(ccov,mag,by=c("chrom"="CTG"))
#we compute mag coverage
mag_cov=ccov %>% group_by(MAG) %>%summarize(l=sum(length),bases=sum(bases)) %>% mutate(mean_cov=bases/l)
#we compute number of mutations per MAG
mag_mut=fixed_data %>% group_by(MAG) %>% summarize(count=n())
#we join mag mut and cov
mag_mut_cov=left_join(mag_mut,mag_cov)
mag_mut_cov$mutations_per_megabase <- mag_mut_cov$count / (mag_mut_cov$l / 1e6)
#we plot mutations per megabase

#we load some mag stats from checkM result
mag_qual=read.delim("../data/MAG_SMAG/mags_mining_S15.tsv",header=T)
mag_qual$mag=paste0(mag_qual$mag_name,".",mag_qual$mag_id)
mag_qual=mag_qual %>% select(mag,phylum,class,order,completeness,contamination,strain_heterogeneity,genome_size,gc,N50)
mag_mut_cov_tax=left_join(mag_mut_cov,mag_qual, by=c("MAG"="mag"))

```

we build a linear model to check if variants can be explained by some variable

```{r lmodel}
a=lm(data=mag_mut_cov_tax,log(mutations_per_megabase)~mean_cov+contamination+gc+strain_heterogeneity+completeness+phylum)
summary(a)

# we plot some interesting associations
# Fit a linear model
model <- lm(log(mutations_per_megabase) ~ strain_heterogeneity, data = mag_mut_cov_tax)

# Extract R-squared and p-value
r_squared <- summary(a)$r.squared
p_value <- summary(a)$coefficients[5, 4]

p1=ggplot(mag_mut_cov_tax, aes(x=strain_heterogeneity,y=log(mutations_per_megabase), color=phylum)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +  # Add points
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "blue", linetype = "dashed") +  # Add linear model
  labs(
    title = "Mutations per Megabase vs Strain heterogeneity",
    x = "Strain heterogeneity",
    y = "Mutations per Megabase"
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = max(mag_mut_cov_tax$strain_heterogeneity) * 0.7, y = max(log(mag_mut_cov_tax$mutations_per_megabase)), 
           label = paste0("R² = ", round(r_squared, 3), 
                          "\nP-value = ", signif(p_value, 3)), 
           color = "black", size = 5, hjust = 0) +
  theme_minimal()

# Fit a linear model
model <- lm(mutations_per_megabase ~ gc, data = mag_mut_cov_tax)

# Extract R-squared and p-value
r_squared <- summary(model)$r.squared
p_value <- summary(model)$coefficients[2, 4]

p2=ggplot(mag_mut_cov_tax, aes(x=gc,y=mutations_per_megabase, color=phylum)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +  # Add points
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "blue", linetype = "dashed") +  # Add linear model
  labs(
    title = "Mutations per Megabase vs GC-content",
    x = "GC-content",
    y = "Mutations per Megabase"
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = max(mag_mut_cov_tax$gc) * 0.7, y = max(mag_mut_cov_tax$mutations_per_megabase), 
           label = paste0("R² = ", round(r_squared, 3), 
                          "\nP-value = ", signif(p_value, 3)), 
           color = "black", size = 5, hjust = 0) +
  theme_minimal()


# Fit a linear model
model <- lm(mutations_per_megabase ~ mean_cov, data = mag_mut_cov_tax)

# Extract R-squared and p-value
r_squared <- summary(model)$r.squared
p_value <- summary(model)$coefficients[2, 4]

p3=ggplot(mag_mut_cov_tax, aes(x=mean_cov,y=mutations_per_megabase, color=phylum)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +  # Add points
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "blue", linetype = "dashed") +  # Add linear model
  labs(
    title = "Mutations per Megabase vs Genome Coverage",
    x = "Genome coverage",
    y = "Mutations per Megabase"
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = max(mag_mut_cov_tax$mean_cov) * 0.7, y = max(mag_mut_cov_tax$mutations_per_megabase), 
           label = paste0("R² = ", round(r_squared, 3), 
                          "\nP-value = ", signif(p_value, 3)), 
           color = "black", size = 5, hjust = 0) +
  theme_minimal()


(p1+p2+p3) + plot_layout(guides = "collect") & theme(legend.position = "bottom")

```


Plot by phylum

```{r fplot}
library(ggplot2)

# Plot mutations per megabase by phylum
ggplot(mag_mut_cov_tax, aes(x = phylum, y = log(mutations_per_megabase), fill = phylum)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_y_log10() +  # Use log10 scale for better visualization if the range is wide
  labs(
    title = "Variants per Megabase by Phylum",
    x = "Phylum",
    y = "Variants per Megabase"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))  # Rotate x-axis labels

```
